text: At baseline, LysoSensor measurements showed lysosomes in APOE4 microglia were significantly more acidic (lower pH) than in APOE3 microglia.
description: Primary microglia from forebrains of P1-3 homozygous APOE3 and APOE4 targeted-replacement mice (C57BL/6, Taconic 1548/1549), 8-10 pups pooled per litter; each litter is an independent experiment; sex not determined (pooled). Cells were enriched after 4 weeks of mixed glial culture. Assay: 2 µM LysoSensor Green DND-189 for 10 min, then flow cytometry gated on DAPI-negative live cells, with a pHrodo Green AM calibration curve. Caveat: mouse neonatal microglia, not human astrocytes; measures lysosomal rather than endosomal pH; in vitro culture.

provenance.excerpt: We then further used LysoSensor dye to measure the pH of lysosomes, which were significantly more acidic in E4 microglia when compared to E3 microglia (Figure S3).

meccogFinding.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (lower lysosomal pH in microglia at baseline)
